children: Executed with Signpost India, the outdoor activation transforms a bus shelter into a shoppable display featuring fashion accessories, footwear and apparel

Flipkart has transformed an ordinary bus stop into a makeshift fashion store as part of its Big Billion Days 2026 campaign, bringing products directly to commuters through an interactive outdoor advertising (OOH) installation.

Executed in collaboration with Signpost India, the installation features sneakers, caps, bags and apparel displayed on shelves within a bus shelter. A QR code allows commuters to scan and shop, connecting the physical installation with Flipkart’s online marketplace.

The activation uses the tagline, “This bus stop identifies as a drip stop”, turning the everyday commute into a brand engagement opportunity. By combining product displays with QR-enabled shopping, Flipkart brings an element of retail into public infrastructure while building visibility for its festive sale.
